lead_editorial.title: Patakhon par adalat ne beech ka raasta nikaala — ab use zameen par laagu karna prashasan aur nagrikon ki jimmedari hai
lead_editorial.summary: Supreme Court ne Diwali ke do dinon ke liye seemit chhoot di hai, usi din jab Delhi ki hawa 'very poor' ho gayi. Yeh santulan tabhi kaam karega jab niyamon ka paalan sakhti se ho.
body: Supreme Court ne Somvaar ko Delhi-NCR mein 7 aur 8 November ko sirf CSIR-NEERI se manzoor green patakhe chalaane ki ijaazat di — subah 6 se 7 aur raat 8 se 10 baje tak. 9 November se poori paabandi phir laagu ho jaayegi. Usi din CAQM ne GRAP ka doosra charan laagu kiya, kyunki The Week ke mutabik AQI 31 October ke 117 se badhkar Somvaar ko 327 tak pahunch gaya.

Hamari raay mein adalat ne aastha aur swasthya ke beech ek vyavahaarik raasta chuna hai. LiveLaw ki report ke mutabik bench ne khud maana ki poori paabandi aadarsh lag sakti hai, lekin aisa data kaafi nahi hai jo saabit kare ki sirf patakhe band karne se pradooshan ka masla hal ho jaata hai. Yeh imaandaar sweekarokti hai — Delhi ki hawa ka sankat parali, gaadiyon, nirmaan ki dhool aur mausam ka milaa-jula nateeja hai, aur ise ek tyohaar ke sir nahi madha ja sakta.

Lekin chhoot ka matlab tabhi hai jab niyam toote nahi. Adalat ne saaf kaha hai ki barium waale aur paaramparik patakhon ki bikri aur aavaajaahi rokna adhikaariyon ka kaam hai, aur aspataalon, schoolon va old-age homes ke 300 metre ke daayre ko 'No-Cracker Zone' ghoshit kar laagu karna hoga. Pichhle varshon ka anubhav batata hai ki samay-seema aksar sirf kaagaz par rehti hai. Police aur nagar nigam ko pehle se dukaanon ki jaanch aur shikaayat ke liye helpline jaisi vyavastha karni chahiye.

Aakhir mein jimmedari nagrikon ki bhi hai. Do ghante ki khidki ko poori raat ka utsav banaana un bachchon aur buzurgon ke saath anyaay hai jinke liye 'very poor' hawa sehat ka seedha khatra hai. Diwali roshni ka tyohaar hai; ise dhuen ka tyohaar banne se bachaana hum sabke haath mein hai — aur yahi is faisle ki asli pariksha hogi.

stories.title: Cyclone Murasu ka landfall shuru: raat 1 baje Ongole ke paas aankh tat se takraayi, 110 kmph tak hawa; CM Naidu ne kaha — jaan bachaana sabse badi praathmikta
stories.summary: IMD ke mutabik 'severe cyclonic storm' Murasu ka landfall Mangalvaar raat 1 baje Prakasam zile mein Ongole ke paas shuru hua. Subah tak 100-110 kmph hawa aur 1-1.5 metre storm surge ki chetavani.
body: Bay of Bengal se utha Cyclone Murasu Mangalvaar tadke dakshin Andhra Pradesh ke tat par pahuncha. PTI ke hawaale se ThePrint ki report ke mutabik IMD ne kaha ki 'landfall process' 3 November ko raat 1 baje Ongole ke paas shuru hua; raat 1:30 baje toofan ka kendra Ongole se kareeb 40 km dakshin-poorv, Kavali se 60 km aur Bapatla se 70 km door tha. Asianet Newsable ki subah 5:51 baje ki report ke mutabik IMD ne bataaya ki toofan ki 'wall cloud' ka bada hissa zameen par aa chuka hai aur iski aankh Kothapatnam ke paas tat mein pravesh kar rahi hai; landfall ki prakriya kuch aur ghante chalne ka anumaan tha.

IMD ne subah tak tat ke kinaare 100-110 kmph ki hawa aur 120 kmph tak ke jhonkon ki chetavani di hai. Dakshin Coastal Andhra mein agle 12 ghante bhaari baarish ho sakti hai, aur 1 se 1.5 metre ka storm surge nichle ilaakon mein paani bhar sakta hai — sabse zyaada khatra Bapatla, Krishna aur Prakasam zilon mein bataaya gaya hai. Adhikaariyon ke mutabik raat mein Ongole mein madhyam baarish aur Nellore va Kothapatnam mein halki boondaa-baandi darj hui.

Mukhyamantri N. Chandrababu Naidu ne adhikaariyon ko high alert par rehne aur jaan-maal ka nuksaan rokne ko sabse oopar rakhne ka nirdesh diya. Unhone kaha ki pichhle Cyclone Arnab ke dauraan hui maut jaisi ghatnaayein Murasu mein nahi doharaayi jaani chahiye. Prabhaavit ilaakon ke logon ko toofan guzarne tak gharon mein rehne, nehron aur sinchaai talaabon mein daraar rokne aur bijli vibhaag ko toote khambon ki turant marammat ke liye taiyaar rehne ko kaha gaya hai. Subah tak kisi maut ya nuksaan ka aadhikaarik aankda saamne nahi aaya tha.

stories.title: Supreme Court ne Delhi-NCR mein 7-8 November ko green patakhon ki di chhoot, sirf do time slot; usi din AQI 327 par pahuncha, GRAP-II laagu
stories.summary: Patakhe sirf subah 6-7 aur raat 8-10 baje chal sakenge, 9 November se poori paabandi waapas. Teen din mein AQI 117 se 327 tak chadha, CAQM ne koyla-lakdi jalane par roak lagaayi.
body: Supreme Court ne Somvaar ko Delhi-NCR mein Chhoti Diwali aur Diwali — 7 aur 8 November — ko green patakhe chalaane ki seemit ijaazat di. Free Press Journal ki report ke mutabik sirf CSIR-NEERI se manzoor, certified nirmaataon ke green patakhe subah 6 se 7 baje aur raat 8 se 10 baje tak chalaaye ja sakenge. Barium waale aur doosre gair-manzoor patakhe pratibandhit rahenge, aur 9 November se poore NCR mein paabandi phir laagu ho jaayegi. Aspataalon, nursing homes, schoolon, old-age homes aur silence zones ke 300 metre ke daayre mein patakhe nahi chalenge; sthaaniya prashasan ko inhe 'No-Cracker Zone' ghoshit karna hoga.

LiveLaw ke mutabik sunvaai ke dauraan adalat ne tippani ki ki poori paabandi aadarsh lagti hai, lekin aisa paryaapt data nahi hai jo dikhaaye ki isse vaayu pradooshan ki samasya hal hoti hai. Usi din court ne Diwali par mehnge hawaai kiraayon ke khilaaf yachika ki jaldi sunvaai se bhi inkaar kar diya.

Is beech Delhi ki hawa tezi se bigdi hai. The Week ki report ke mutabik AQI 31 October ko 117, 1 November ko 261 aur Somvaar ko 327 ('very poor') tak pahunch gaya, jiske baad Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) ne GRAP ka Stage II laagu kiya. Iske tahat koyle aur lakdi ke istemaal par roak, diesel generator par sakhti, parking fees mein badhottari aur sadkon par mechanical sweeping va paani ke chhidkaav jaise kadam shaamil hain. IMD aur IITM ka anumaan hai ki aane waale dinon mein bhi hawa 'very poor' shreni mein rahegi.

editorial.title: Murasu tat paar kar gaya, ab pariksha bahaali ki hai
body: Andhra prashasan ne toofan se pehle chetavani, evacuation aur 'ghar ke andar raho' ke sandesh ko gaon-gaon tak pahunchaane ki koshish ki — yeh sahi disha thi. Mukhyamantri ka yeh kehna ki Arnab jaisi maut doharaayi na jaayein, ek saaf maapdand bhi tay karta hai jis par sarkaar ko parkha jaayega.

Hamari raay mein ab asli kaam shuru hota hai: bijli aur mobile network ki tez bahaali, nichle ilaakon se paani nikaalna, aur kisaanon va machhuaaron ke nuksaan ka paardarshi aakalan. Kuch hi dinon mein do toofan jhelne waale tatiya zilon ke liye raahat ka paisa aur muavza bina deri pahunchna chahiye — wahi bharose ki asli neev hai.

stories.title: America mein aaj midterms: poore House, 35 Senate seaton aur 36 governor padon par voting; nateeje Bharat mein Budhvaar subah se aane shuru honge
stories.summary: Republicans ke paas dono sadanon mein patla bahumat hai; Democrats ko har sadan mein chaar seaton ka shuddh faayda chahiye. Trump ne baar-baar ishaara kiya hai ki chunaav ke baad Iran par hamle dobara ho sakte hain.
body: America mein Mangalvaar, 3 November ko midterm chunaav ho rahe hain. Euronews ki report ke mutabik House of Representatives ki sabhi 435 seaton, Senate ki 100 mein se 35 seaton aur 36 rajyon ke governor padon ke liye voting hogi, saath hi hazaaron sthaaniya muqable bhi hain. Abhi Republicans ke paas dono sadanon mein kam antar ka bahumat hai, aur Democrats ko niyantran ke liye har sadan mein chaar seaton ka shuddh faayda chahiye. Senate ke liye Maine, Ohio, North Carolina, Iowa aur Georgia ko sabse ahem maana ja raha hai. TheStreet ke mutabik pollsters Democrats ko dono sadan jeetne ka daavedaar maan rahe hain, haalaanki Senate ka muqabla kareebi ho sakta hai.

Voting East Coast par sabse pehle khatm hogi, isliye shuruaati rujhaan wahin se aayenge; Bharatiya samay ke hisaab se nateeje Budhvaar subah se aane lagenge. Anadolu Agency ke mutabik chunaav se pehle Michigan mein Democratic saansad Haley Stevens ne Senate race mein Republican Mike Rogers ka samarthan kar diya, jise Democratic ummeedwaar Abdul El-Sayed ke liye jhatka maana ja raha hai.

Chunaav par West Asia ki chhaaya bhi hai. Al Jazeera ke mutabik Iran ne kaha hai ki uski saat-charan waali yuddhviraam yojana ab do din mein laagu ho sakti hai, jiske kendra mein Strait of Hormuz kholna aur parmaanu baatcheet hai — par Washington ne ise maana ho, aisa koi sanket nahi hai. CBS News ke mutabik Trump ne kaha ki unke paas Iran mein 'ek-do target' baaki hain, aur Axios ke sootron ke hawaale se Israeli PM Netanyahu chunaav ke turant baad naye hamlon par zor de rahe hain, jabki Trump abhi baatcheet ko mauka dena chahte hain.

stories.title: Ukraine-Russia ke beech 10-11 November ko Abu Dhabi mein America ki madhyasthata mein baatcheet; Witkoff ne kiya elaan
stories.summary: Iran yuddh se pehle February ke baad yeh pehla US-madhyasth daur hoga. Agenda mein yuddh ke baad ki suraksha vyavastha, tanaav kam karna aur maanviya kadam.
body: America ke vishesh doot Steve Witkoff ne Somvaar ko social media par bataaya ki Ukraine aur Russia ke pratinidhimandalon ke beech 10-11 November ko Abu Dhabi mein America ki madhyasthata mein trilateral baatcheet hogi. Reuters ke hawaale se Al-Monitor ki report ke mutabik Witkoff ne kaha ki charcha yuddh ke baad ke suraksha samjhauton, tanaav ghataane, maanviya upaayon aur yuddh khatm karne par hogi. Ek varishth US adhikaari ke mutabik Witkoff aur Jared Kushner khud maujood rahenge.

Report ke mutabik Putin ne do hafte pehle St Petersburg mein Witkoff se mulaakaat ke baad is naye daur par sahmati di thi. Pichhla US-madhyasth daur February mein hua tha, US-Israel aur Iran ke yuddh se pehle. Is hafte US negotiators Brussels mein France, Germany, Britain, EU aur NATO ke saath Ukraine ki suraksha guarantee aur punarnirmaan ke paise par bhi baithak karenge. Dono deshon ki shartein abhi bhi kaafi door hain.

Anadolu Agency ke mutabik Kremlin sahayak Yury Ushakov ne kaha ki Putin ne Zelenskyy se baatcheet se kabhi inkaar nahi kiya. Isi beech Kherson ke Russia-niyantrit shehar Oleshky mein maanviya madad ke liye kai din ka yuddhviraam Ravivaar der raat bina kisi ullanghan ke khatm hua.

stories.title: Bulgaria mein Iliana Yotova ne runoff jeeta, banengi desh ki pehli nirvachit mahila rashtrapati; Ukraine ko hathiyaar dene ki virodhi
stories.summary: Shuruaati nateejon aur exit polls mein Yotova ko lagbhag 57-58% vote mile; pro-Western pratidwandi Andrey Gyurov ne haar sweekaar ki.
body: Bulgaria ke Ravivaar ko hue rashtrapati chunaav ke runoff mein kaaryavaahak rashtrapati Iliana Yotova ki badi jeet hui hai. Al Jazeera ke mutabik kai polling agenciyon ki ginti mein unhe kareeb 58 pratishat vote mile, jabki unke pratidwandi, banker aur poorv antarim pradhanmantri Andrey Gyurov kareeb 38 pratishat par rahe; Anadolu Agency ne exit polls mein 57 banaam 39 pratishat ka aankda diya. Aadhikaarik nateeje aane baaki the. Gyurov ne kaha ki nateejon ko jaisa hai waisa sweekaarna hoga.

61 varshiya Yotova January mein tab kaaryavaahak rashtrapati bani thin jab unke sahyogi Rumen Radev ne sansadiya chunaav ladne ke liye istifa diya — jo Radev ne jeeta. Yotova Russia ke saath samvaad ki pakshdhar hain aur Ukraine ko sainya madad ka virodh karti hain; unka kehna hai ki shaanti sirf baatcheet se aa sakti hai. Gyurov ne unpar Black Sea mein jahaazon par hue drone hamlon ke liye Russia ko seedhe zimmedar na thehraane ka aarop lagaaya tha.

Al Jazeera ke mutabik turnout kareeb 27-29 pratishat raha. Bulgaria mein rashtrapati ka pad mukhyatah aupchaarik hai, lekin EU aur NATO sadasya desh mein Ukraine-niti par yeh nateeja ahem sanket maana ja raha hai. European Commission ki adhyaksh Ursula von der Leyen ne Yotova ko badhaai di.

editorial.title: Midterms ka nateeja sirf America ka maamla nahi — Tehran se Kyiv tak iski goonj hogi
body: Aaj ka chunaav tay karega ki Trump ke kaarykaal ke baaki do saal Congress ki rok-tok ke saath chalenge ya bina uske. Iran par hamlon ka sawaal, Ukraine samjhauta aur tariff-niti — teeno par Congress ka rukh badalne se duniya bhar ka hisaab badal sakta hai.

Hamari raay mein Bharat ke liye sabse bada daanv West Asia ki sthirta hai, kyunki Hormuz ka band rehna tel ki keemat aur khaadi mein base Bharatiyon, dono par asar daalta hai. Chunaav ke baad Washington ko jaldbaazi ke bajaay usi baatcheet ko mauka dena chahiye jise khud Trump 'theek chal rahi' bata rahe hain.

stories.title: Apple ki record September timahi: revenue 12% badhkar $114.5 billion, iPhone se $57.6 billion; CEO John Ternus ki pehli earnings call
stories.summary: EPS $2.10 raha, anumaan $2.00 tha. Poore fiscal 2026 mein revenue $479 billion — company ka ab tak ka sabse behtar saal. Phir bhi growth dheemi hone ki chinta mein share gira.
body: Apple ne Somvaar ko America mein baazaar band hone ke baad apne fiscal 2026 ki chauthi timahi (July-September) ke nateeje jaari kiye. 9to5Mac ke mutabik revenue saal-dar-saal 12% badhkar $114.48 billion raha, jo company ke 9-11% ke guidance se bhi oopar hai. Shuddh munafa $30.71 billion aur prati share kamaai (EPS) $2.10 rahi. TheStreet ke mutabik Wall Street ka anumaan $113.47 billion revenue aur $2.00 EPS ka tha.

Segment ke hisaab se iPhone se $57.58 billion, Services se $31.57 billion, Mac se $10.79 billion, Wearables-Home-Accessories se $8.30 billion aur iPad se $6.23 billion aaye. CEO John Ternus ne — jinki yeh pehli earnings call thi — ise September timahi ka record bataaya aur kaha ki Services ne ab tak ka sabse ooncha star chhua. CFO Kevan Parekh ke mutabik poore fiscal 2026 mein revenue $479 billion raha.

Ummeed se behtar nateejon ke baavjood TheStreet ke mutabik Apple ka share kareeb 1.8% gira, kyunki niveshkon ki nazar growth ki raftaar dheemi padne par thi. Somvaar ko America mein tech sheyaron par dabaav raha aur Nasdaq kareeb 1.1% neeche band hua.

stories.title: Marvell kharidegi AI optics company Lumentum, $115 billion ka all-stock sauda; tech itihaas ke sabse bade soudon mein shumaar
stories.summary: Marvell ka daava — milkar banegi 'AI connectivity' ki category leader. Elaan ke baad dono companiyon ke share gire.
body: Chip company Marvell Technology ne Somvaar ko data center ke liye lasers aur optical switches banaane waali Lumentum Holdings ko $115 billion ke all-stock saude mein kharidne ka elaan kiya. CBS News ke mutabik ise tech industry ke ab tak ke sabse bade soudon mein gina ja raha hai. Marvell ke CEO Matt Murphy ka kehna hai ki AI infrastructure tezi se optical connectivity ki taraf badh raha hai, aur sanyukt company is kshetra ki 'category leader' hogi.

Bloomberg ke hawaale se CBS ne bataaya ki Nvidia ne is saal ki shuruaat mein Lumentum mein $2 billion ki hissedaari kharidne ka samjhauta kiya tha. Saude ki prati-share shartein aur poora hone ki samay-seema report mein nahi di gayi.

Baazaar ne sauda thande man se liya. TheStreet ke mutabik Somvaar ko Lumentum ka share kareeb 10.3% aur Marvell ka 5.3% gira. Usi din Oracle ne $10 billion ke share aur $10 billion ke bond offering ka elaan kiya, jisse uska share kareeb 5% phisla — AI kharch ko lekar niveshkon ki chinta saaf dikhi.

stories.title: Wall Street mila-jula: Dow chadha, Nasdaq 1.1% gira; Iran baatcheet ki ummeed mein crude phisla, Gift Nifty sapaat shuruaat ka sanket
stories.summary: S&P 500 0.5% neeche 7,541 par, Dow 0.4% oopar 51,984 par. Brent $108-109 ke aaspaas aaya; Somvaar ko Nifty 23,440.80 par band hua tha.
body: America ke sheyar baazaar Somvaar ko mile-jule rahe. AP ke hawaale se Yahoo Finance ki report ke mutabik S&P 500 0.5% girkar 7,541.40 par aur Nasdaq kareeb 1.1% girkar 25,164 ke aaspaas band hua, jabki Dow Jones 213.67 ank (0.4%) chadhkar 51,983.98 par pahuncha. Subah ki tezi tech aur AI sheyaron mein pichhle hafte ki bikvaali ke asar se feeki pad gayi; Nvidia shuruaati badhat ke baad laal nishaan mein chala gaya.

Tel ki keemat mein badi giraavat aayi. HDFC Sky ke mutabik Iran yuddh par baatcheet se samjhaute ki ummeed mein Brent 4.14% girkar $108.73 aur WTI 4.18% girkar $99.77 prati barrel par aaya; Brent Shukravaar ko $118 ke chhah maheene ke uchch star par tha. Sasta tel airline sheyaron ke liye achha raha — TheStreet ke mutabik United Airlines kareeb 7.4% chadha.

Bharatiya baazaar ke liye HDFC Sky ki Somvaar shaam ki report ke mutabik Gift Nifty ka November contract 23,400 par tha, jo Nifty ke Somvaar ke 23,440.80 ke band star se thoda neeche hai — yaani sapaat shuruaat ka sanket. Aaj America ke midterm chunaav aur Iran par agla kadam baazaar ki disha tay karne waale bade kaaran rahenge. (Yeh report keval jaankaari ke liye hai, nivesh salaah nahi.)

editorial.title: Record munafa aur $115 billion ke saude ke baavjood baazaar ka thanda rukh ek chetavani hai
body: Apple ne record timahi di, Marvell ne AI ke liye itihaas ka ek bada daanv lagaaya — phir bhi dono ke share gire. Iska matlab hai ki niveshak ab sirf 'AI' shabd par paisa nahi laga rahe; woh poochh rahe hain ki itne bhaari kharch ka munafa kab aur kitna lautega.

Hamari raay mein Bharatiya IT aur semiconductor mahatvakaankshaon ke liye yeh sabak hai: AI ki daud mein jeet unki hogi jo kharch ko thos kamaai mein badal sakein. Saath hi, crude ki giraavat Bharat ke liye raahat hai, par jab tak Hormuz par anishchitata hai, yeh raahat kachchi hai.

stories.title: 'Ramayana: Part 1' ki advance booking Rs 46 crore ke paar, 11 lakh se zyada ticket bike; Ranbir-Sai Pallavi-Yash ki film 5 November ko release
stories.summary: Sacnilk ke aankdon ke mutabik Hindi version se Rs 38.7 crore aaye; 3D format sabse aage. NCR aur Mumbai booking mein top par.
body: Nitesh Tiwari ki 'Ramayana: Part 1' release se pehle hi record ki raah par dikh rahi hai. Business Standard ne box office tracker Sacnilk ke aankdon ke hawaale se bataaya ki Somvaar dopahar tak film ne Bharat mein block tickets samet kul Rs 46.63 crore ki advance booking kar li thi, aur 35,855 shows ke liye 11.17 lakh se zyada ticket bik chuke the. Isme Hindi version ka hissa Rs 38.70 crore (lagbhag 84%) hai, jabki Kannada se Rs 4.41 crore aur Telugu se Rs 2.35 crore aaye.

Format ke hisaab se Hindi 3D sabse aage hai — Rs 21.57 crore, yaani kul ka lagbhag 47%. IMAX, 4DX aur Dolby Cinema jaise premium formats ne sirf 2% shows se Rs 8.83 crore kamaaye. Shehron mein NCR (Rs 6.78 crore), Mumbai (Rs 6.08 crore) aur Bengaluru (Rs 5.79 crore) sabse aage hain; rajyon mein Maharashtra Rs 9.42 crore ke saath top par hai.

Film mein Ranbir Kapoor Ram, Sai Pallavi Sita, Yash Raavan, Sunny Deol Hanuman aur Ravi Dubey Lakshman ki bhoomika mein hain. Sangeet Hans Zimmer aur AR Rahman ka hai, aur film Namit Malhotra ke Prime Focus Studios ne DNEG aur Yash ki Monster Mind Creations ke saath banaayi hai. Film Diwali hafte mein 5 November ko release ho rahi hai.

stories.title: Kal Eden Park mein New Zealand se pehla ODI: Gill ki kaptaani mein Rohit-Kohli ki vaapsi ki ummeed, report ke mutabik Bumrah ko aaraam; NZ ke Ravindra aur Chapman chot ke kaaran baahar
stories.summary: Paanch match ki series ka pehla muqabla Budhvaar subah 7:30 baje (IST) Auckland mein. Nitish Kumar Reddy sirf pehle ODI ke liye team mein; Test series 19 November se.
body: Bharat ka New Zealand daura Budhvaar, 4 November ko Auckland ke Eden Park mein pehle ODI ke saath shuru hoga. Yahoo Sports ke mutabik match Bharatiya samay ke anusaar subah 7:30 baje shuru hoga. Shubman Gill pehle teen ODI mein kaptaani karenge, jabki BCCI ke mutabik aakhri do match mein Shreyas Iyer team ki kaman sambhaalenge.

Aryan Age ki report ke mutabik Rohit Sharma aur Virat Kohli opener mein vaapsi karte dikh sakte hain, jabki workload ke chalte Shreyas Iyer ko aaraam dekar Ruturaj Gaikwad ko mauka mil sakta hai. Yahoo Sports ke mutabik Jasprit Bumrah ko aaraam diya gaya hai. BCCI ne 30 October ko bataaya tha ki Nitish Kumar Reddy sirf pehle ODI ke liye team mein hain, uske baad woh India A ke saath match practice karenge, jabki hamstring chot se ubar rahe Prasidh Krishna ODI series se baahar hain.

Mezbaan team Mitchell Santner ki kaptaani mein utregi; Yahoo Sports ke mutabik Rachin Ravindra aur Mark Chapman chot ke kaaran uplabdh nahi hain. Eden Park par ab tak ke aankde chase karne waali team ke paksh mein rahe hain. ODI series ke baad dono teamon ke beech do Test match ki series 19 November se shuru hogi.

editorial.title: 'Ramayana' ki booking batati hai ki darshak bade parde ka anubhav chahte hain — ab film ko kahaani se jeetna hoga
body: Rs 46 crore se zyada ki advance booking, aur usme 3D va premium formats ka bada hissa, dikhata hai ki darshak aaj bhi theatre ka 'event' anubhav chahte hain. Hindi ke saath Kannada aur Telugu ki booking yeh bhi batati hai ki ek pan-India mahakaavya bhasha ki deewaar tod sakta hai.

Hamari raay mein advance booking sirf shuruaati utsaah hai; film ki asli pariksha pehle weekend ke baad ki word-of-mouth hogi. Itni badi ummeedon ke saath, kahaani aur bhaavna ki imaandaari hi tay karegi ki yeh Bharatiya cinema ka naya maapdand banti hai ya sirf ek tez shuruaat.
